## HAPI v0.27.2.2

### Compared with the previous maintained release

Rebuilt from current `upstream/main` (f63d4bb8) with the maintained distribution overlay and carries. Drops the seven carries upstream already merged (#1430, #1442, #1420, #1415, #1411, #1410, #1433) and adds new carries: unified agent configuration descriptors (#1469), ACP cost usage (#1468), composer model/effort value buttons (#1475), voice dictation credential presets (#1474), Create agent visibility (#1451), drag sessions into composer mentions (#1418), AGENT_NOTIFY_SUMMARY chat display settings (#1477), pin active sessions (#1447), Claude local session history import (#1429), and notification preferences with custom web push copy (#1360). Retains the previous carries (#1091, #987, #986, #847, #1108, #1424, #1422, #1414, #1413, #1158, #955, #906, #1436, #1421, #1419, desktop #769). PR #1443 (mid-turn steer) is dropped as superseded by the carried #906. Schema bumps to 27 (cost columns at v25→v26, notification preferences at v26→v27).

### Compared with the official release

Same maintained overlay as `v0.27.2.1` plus the carries above, rebuilt on `upstream/main` f63d4bb8 (a2a work-graph #1467, Codex-family permission mode #1410, bracketed Cursor wire remap #1430, and everything up to official `v0.27.2`). Desktop launcher packaging (#769) remains included with the four-part-version and bun-layout packaging fixes.

### Maintained-fork guarantees

Release tags are published only from commits contained in `main`; macOS artifacts retain the `xyz.hapi.cli` signing identity; app-shell cache headers remain no-store. GitHub auto-generated release notes are never published — the curated notes in this file are used instead.
